qualities.title: Qualities
qualities.intro: Our oak panels are available in several quality grades. Each quality has its own character and applications.

ab.name: A/B Quality
ab.description: The highest quality. One side is completely flawless and carefully selected by colour. Ideal for visible applications such as furniture, tabletops and wall cladding.

rustic.name: Rustic
rustic.description: Natural character with visible knots. Knots with a diameter up to 30-35 mm, knots not repaired. Provides a warm, authentic appearance.

features.0: Knots up to Ø 30-35 mm, not repaired
features.2: Popular for rustic and country-style projects

prime.name: Prime / Natural
prime.description: A beautiful balance between A/B and Rustic. Small knots and natural grain are permitted, providing a lively yet refined appearance.

panels.title: Panel Types
panels.intro: We offer various panel construction types, each with their own properties and applications.

fingerJoint.name: Finger Joint
fingerJoint.description: Lamellas are joined using a finger joint connection. This results in a strong and stable panel. The joints are subtly visible and give the panel a characteristic look. Very suitable for worktops and structural applications.

continuous.name: Continuous Lamella
continuous.description: The lamellas run the full length of the panel without interruptions. This creates a calm and elegant appearance. Premium choice for tabletops, furniture and high-end interior projects.

threeLayer.name: Three-Layer Panel
threeLayer.description: Constructed from three layers of wood glued crosswise. This ensures maximum stability and minimal movement. Extremely suitable for wide panels, tabletops and applications where dimensional stability is crucial.

singleLayer.name: Single-Layer Panel (Solid)
singleLayer.description: Fully solid panel consisting of one layer of glued lamellas. Ideal for thicker applications and when the solid appearance of real wood is desired.

origins.title: Origins
origins.intro: The origin of the oak wood partly determines the character, colour and grain of the panel.

european.name: European Oak
european.description: Sourced from sustainably managed European forests. Characterised by a warm, golden-brown colour and regular grain. The most versatile choice for various applications.

french.name: French Oak
french.description: Valued for its fine grain structure and light colour. French oak is particularly suitable for elegant interior projects and furniture with a refined appearance.

slavonian.name: Slavonian Oak
slavonian.description: Premium oak wood from the Slavonian forests of Croatia. Known for its exceptionally fine and straight grain, light colour and minimal knots. The choice par excellence for exclusive projects.

american.name: American White Oak
american.description: Slightly lighter in colour than European oak with a more pronounced grain pattern. Very durable and water-resistant, making it also suitable for kitchens and bathrooms.
